rule: Last-bit: finite numeric mismatches <=16 ULP; larger numeric: >16 ULP. This split is triage, not a relaxed verdict. Every mismatch, refusal, unread, missing, pending, external and circular-policy cell remains an inclusive failure. Corpus functions are inferred from formula spelling, unwrapping INDEX selections; bank functions use canonical judge identities. Counts are observations per source; corpus and bank may overlap and must not be added as unique calls. Bank reference/locale context gaps remain failures, not proven numerical defects.
